Facility columns are COUNTS OF SURVEYED VILLAGES in each category, not lengths or km. Road/access columns: all_weather_road (villages connected by all-weather road), cc_road_full/partial/not (internal cement-concrete roads), pub_trans_bus/van/auto/no (public transport available), railway. No road length, road density or road class, so it is a rural connectivity indicator, not a road-network measure. Covers rural villages only; urban areas (most of Bengaluru Urban, city corporations) are excluded, so it is not an accessibility measure for urban charging demand. Survey responses reported by Gram Panchayats, not field-measured. Single year (2020). Karnataka: 30 districts with LGD codes 524-550, 630, 631, 635. Ramanagara still uses that name (LGD 631 = Bengaluru South). Vijayanagar (LGD 738) is absent, presumably within Ballari (528). Spellings differ from LGD names (e.g. 'Dakshin Kannad', 'Uttar Kannad', 'Chikballapur'), so join on district_code. Validation: Karnataka 30 rows, 0 blank cells; cc_road_* and pub_trans_* categories each sum to villages_surveyed in 30/30 districts; all_weather_road <= villages_surveyed in 30/30. KA totals: 32,026 villages surveyed, 22,972 (71.7%) with all-weather road, rural population covered 44,491,460. Lowest all-weather share: Kodagu 363/593.
notes: Purpose: district rural road connectivity and public-transport availability as an accessibility and equity indicator. Do not treat as road length. Raw file stored unchanged.

Mission Antyodaya columns are counts of rural villages, not road length. ma2020_all_weather_road_share is the only computed field (all_weather_road / villages_surveyed). Missing values left blank.
